display.purpose: Hero statements and major cinematic acts set in Cinzel serif.

headline.purpose: Major section divisions and project titles set in balanced roman serif.

title.purpose: Crisp medium-weight titles for services, case studies, and structured panels.

body.purpose: Long-form editorial paragraphs, methodology explanations, and narrative descriptions constrained to 65–75ch.

label.purpose: All-caps tracking for camera telemetry, category chips, and interactive button text.

hud.purpose: 11px tracking for camera settings, status notes, and navigation subtitles.

telemetry.purpose: 10px tabular monospace figures for live timecodes and camera badges.

shadows.name: subtle-light
shadows.purpose: Subtle surface elevation under cards on light cream canvas.

shadows.name: glow-gold
shadows.purpose: Ambient tungsten halo projecting from focused interactive triggers and play buttons.

shadows.name: cinematic-deep
shadows.purpose: Heavy elevation shadow for full-screen video lightbox modals and floating booking drawers.

motion.name: cinematic-ease
motion.purpose: Decelerated inertial easing mimicking heavy high-precision cinema camera rigs.

motion.name: cinematic-slow
motion.purpose: Slow deliberate pacing for atmospheric reveal animations and film strip motion.

motion.name: duration-instant
motion.purpose: Immediate feedback on button and interactive toggle hover states.

motion.name: duration-flow
motion.purpose: Smooth crossfade transitions between filtered categories and video tabs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary conversion button with warm gold fill, midnight navy text, letterspaced typography, and bronze hover state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background-color: #B08D57; color: #0B1320; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 14px 28px; border: 1px solid #B08D57; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; min-height: 48px; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #785920; border-color: #785920; color: #FFFFFF; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(176, 141, 87, 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); background-color: #5B4215; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B08D57; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-icon { transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-icon { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost button with 1px midnight navy border, midnight navy text, and soft cream fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: transparent; color: #0B1320; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 14px 28px; border: 1px solid #0B1320; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; min-height: 48px; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #F6F2EA; border-color: #785920; color: #785920; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background-color: #E8E1D2; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B08D57; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-film-card { background-color: #F6F2EA; border: 1px solid #E6E1D6; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-film-card:hover { border-color: #B08D57; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(11, 19, 32, 0.06); } .ds-card-media { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16/9; background-color: #0B1320; border-bottom: 1px solid #E6E1D6; } .ds-card-badge { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 12px; background: rgba(11, 19, 32, 0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(212, 220, 232, 0.2); color: #D4DCE8; font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-card-content { padding: 24px; } .ds-card-category { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #785920; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Cinzel, serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #0B1320; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 8px 0; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-film-card:hover .ds-card-title { color: #785920; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #4A5568; margin: 0; }

components.name: Custom Select
components.description: Accessible custom select bounded strictly to container width with smooth dropdown menu and bronze selection state.
components.css: .ds-select-container { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 100%; position: relative; } .ds-select-label { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #4A5568; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-select-trigger { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E6E1D6; border-radius: 2px; color: #0B1320; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 48px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-select-trigger:hover { border-color: #B08D57; } .ds-select-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B08D57; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-select-value { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-select-chevron { color: #785920; flex-shrink: 0; margin-left: 8px; }

components.name: Text Input Field
components.description: Clean light form input with high contrast text, minimum 48px touch height, and warm gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 100%; max-width: 400px; } .ds-input-label { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #4A5568; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input-field { background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E6E1D6; border-radius: 2px; color: #0B1320; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; min-height: 48px; box-sizing: border-box; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input-field::placeholder { color: #8C98A8; } .ds-input-field:hover { border-color: #B08D57; } .ds-input-field:focus { border-color: #B08D57; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #B08D57; }

components.css: .ds-viewfinder-hud { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 480px; aspect-ratio: 2.39/1; background-color: #070D16; border: 1px solid rgba(212, 220, 232, 0.15); padding: 16px; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-hud-bracket { position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-color: #B08D57; border-style: solid; } .ds-hud-tl { top: 6px; left: 6px; border-width: 2px 0 0 2px; } .ds-hud-tr { top: 6px; right: 6px; border-width: 2px 2px 0 0; } .ds-hud-bl { bottom: 6px; left: 6px; border-width: 0 0 2px 2px; } .ds-hud-br { bottom: 6px; right: 6px; border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; } .ds-hud-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; } .ds-hud-rec { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-rec-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; background-color: #FF4D4D; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; } .ds-rec-text { color: #FF4D4D; } .ds-hud-timecode { color: #B08D57; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-hud-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px; color: #D4DCE8; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }

components.css: .ds-chip-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; } .ds-filter-chip { background-color: #F6F2EA; border: 1px solid #E6E1D6; color: #4A5568; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; min-height: 36px; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { border-color: #785920; color: #0B1320; } .ds-chip-active { background-color: #0B1320; border-color: #0B1320; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
Boitumelo B Productions is an elite digital exhibition space capturing the craft, gravity, and emotional resonance of prestige Australian visual cinema. The design evokes the tactile atmosphere of a private cinema grading suite: architecturally grounded Midnight Navy surfaces, calibrated warm tungsten highlights, physical celluloid textures, and surgical optical precision. Every interaction is paced with cinematic intentionality, prioritising patient revelation and editorial authority over rapid digital noise.

The interface rejects commoditised video agency tropes—eschewing playful pastels, floating cards, generic SaaS gradients, and bubbly corner radii. Instead, it embraces high-contrast letterboxed frames, 2.39:1 anamorphic ratios, optical lens calibration marks, and measured typography that honours both narrative documentary truth and commercial visual spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Cinematic Midnight Canvas: High-depth Midnight Navy (#0B1320) and Deep Midnight (#070D16) surfaces deliver rich optical gravity, replacing harsh pitch black with a sophisticated architectural tone.
Warm Gold & Bronze Discipline: Warm Gold (#B08D57) deployed with strict 10% scarcity, supported by WCAG AA-compliant Deep Bronze Gold (#785920) for text legibility on light surfaces.
Surgical Optical Precision: Micro 2px chamfers, razor-thin hairline dividers (#E6E1D6), and ARRI/RED-inspired viewfinder HUD framing brackets.

Uncompromising Editorial Rigour: High-legibility tabular monospace telemetry (10px / 11px), balanced headings without single-word orphans, and accessible contrast exceeding WCAG AA across every viewport.

rules.name: The Rarity of Gold Rule
rules.body: Warm Gold (#B08D57) must never occupy more than 10% of any given screen surface. Its prestige and directional power depend entirely on its scarcity. When everything glows gold, nothing commands attention.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: All text elements against surfaces must meet or exceed WCAG 2.2 AA contrast standards (minimum 4.5:1 for body copy; pure white #FFFFFF achieves 18.3:1 against #0B1320, pale slate #D4DCE8 delivers 13.6:1 against #070D16, and bronze gold #785920 delivers 5.42:1 against #F6F2EA).

rules.name: The Balanced Heading Rule
rules.body: All headings (h1 through h6) must enforce text-wrap: balance to prevent awkward typography line breaks and single-word orphans.

rules.name: The Monospace Timecode Rule
rules.body: All technical metadata, frame rates, lens focal lengths, and video timecodes must render in tabular monospace figures to prevent layout jitter during scrub and playback.

rules.name: The 11px Functional Floor Rule
rules.body: Interactive and functional text labels must maintain a minimum font size of 11px (0.6875rem) to guarantee human legibility. Telemetry readouts and camera timecodes at 10px are permitted only when rendered in high-tracking tabular monospace uppercase.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is created through value contrast, border luminance, and subtle tonal layering—never through artificial heavy black drop-shadows. If an element must lift, illuminate its edge with border luminance (#E6E1D6) or ambient gold bloom (rgba(176, 141, 87, 0.2)).

rules.name: The Architectural Precision Rule
rules.body: Corner radii must never exceed 4px on rectangular surfaces. Organic, playful, or bubbly shapes dilute the technical gravitas of the studio and are strictly forbidden.

dos: Do use Australian English spelling across all interface copy, metadata, and studio communications (specialising, visualise, colour, organisation, rigour, calibrated).
Do enforce text-wrap: balance on all headings and text-wrap: pretty on all editorial body paragraphs.
Do maintain a minimum touch target size of 44×44px (ideally 48px) for all interactive buttons, links, and form elements.
Do preserve the 10% rarity cap on Warm Gold (#B08D57), reserving it for moments requiring genuine user focus or conversion.
Do use tabular monospace figures for timecodes, durations, coordinates, and technical film specifications.
Do respect user system motion preferences via @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), disabling large transforms while maintaining instant visual state feedback.
Do use CustomSelect for dropdown fields to prevent native browser popup menus from overflowing container widths.
donts: Don't introduce generic SaaS pastel colours (purple, pink, indigo, neon blue) or cheerful rounded bubble cards.
Don't use decorative heavy black drop-shadows; convey depth through subtle lighting gradients and border illumination.
Don't permit headings to wrap with a single dangling word on the final line (orphans).
Don't render form inputs with font sizes below 16px on mobile viewports to avoid triggering iOS Safari viewport zooming.
Don't use standalone kicker badges directly stacked above <h1> headings; integrate telemetry directly into top diagnostic status bars.
Don't use functional text sizes below 11px.
Don't autoplay audio under any circumstance. All video playback must initialise muted with clear, accessible user audio toggles.
